audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty text was written for a melee/gap-closing enemy ('his melee step-ups', 'Hold W for his gap-close'). Mel is a ranged, immobile artillery mage with no dash.
audit.why: Mel's kit (Radiant Volley 950 range, Solar Snare 1000 range, Rebuttal 250 self-barrier) has zero mobility beyond Rebuttal's move speed. The lane is a range disadvantage, not a dive threat.
audit.corrected: Difficulty stays 5.5/10 EVEN, but the shape is: she outranges your 725 Q, you win the moment you close with E (1050) while Rebuttal is down.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart said 'Skill' for Levels 3, 4-5, First item and 2+ items while the content layer said Lissandra, Lissandra, Lissandra, Mel. The two layers rendered different answers.
audit.why: The whys under those rows already argue for Lissandra from level 3 (E closes on an immobile Mel) and for Mel late (Overwhelm stacking plus Golden Eclipse). The packet levelChart agrees with the content layer.
audit.corrected: phases[2..5].side to Lissandra, phases[6].side to Mel, with phases[6].why rewritten to match the new verdict. win[N] already carries these values, so no content-layer flip is required.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rebuttal was described only as 'reflects your projectiles' with no cooldown, and the page never stated that BOTH of Lissandra's engage tools are projectiles. breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26s and reflects projectiles while preventing damage. Ice Shard (Q, projectile flag) and Glacial Path (E, the claw, projectile) both feed it. Solar Snare (E) is an 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s root that is the only thing that stops your approach.
audit.corrected: Named the real cooldowns (Rebuttal 38s rank 1 / 26s maxed, Solar Snare 11s, Frozen Tomb 120s) and stated that Q and the claw both reflect.

audit.whatIsWrong: The brief's missingInteractions flagged Searing Brilliance as an auto-attack reset burst tell and Rebuttal as a burst-absorber; neither reached the page.
audit.why: Mel gains bonus projectiles on her next attack after any ability, so the auto wind-up after a spell is the damage, not the spell.
audit.corrected: Folded into phases[0].why and the cooldowns field.

audit.why: 56.74% over 2300 games matches the page's EVEN-leaning-favourable framing.
